goal: Produce a publishable-quality, evidence-grounded NeurIPS rebuttal and ACL resubmission plan for OpenReview submission 36320.

winner.label: persuasive-evidence-audited-v9
winner.primary_finding: Use reviewer-specific, acceptance-oriented replacements that foreground the submitted audit contribution, withdraw the unauditable five-seed transfer claim, answer 4G4H with exact telemetry, and treat private post-submission E1 only as inconclusive feasibility evidence.

findings: The five W&B pairs reproduce .926 versus .921 and recomputed p=.3739. Three are zero-runtime W&B backfills; seed-45/46 have plausible source-run alignment but the backfills cannot be uniquely mapped.
The Qwen PPO .350 and .225 values are separate Modal runs and cannot share one table row without a selection rule.
The submitted early rule has only two positive failures among 22 heterogeneous runs and is not validated as a predictor or stopping rule.
The submitted runner is not standard GRPO; empirical transfer is not established.

E1 has a complete 40-unit private ledger, but a statistical re-audit found a 1.012 pp finite-sample MDE above the 1 pp gate and an unapplied multiplicity step; all four comparisons are treated as inconclusive.

A live Hugging Face audit resolves all 40 frozen E1 repository/commit pairs, six checkpoint states per unit, final adapters, and byte-matching 500-row manifests; four units lack only the evaluation-resume sidecar.
The supported use-inspired application is a pre-adoption audit of RLVR algorithm claims; no stopping-controller, deployment, or compute-saving claim is made.
next_actions: Paste the four replacement texts into their corresponding OpenReview notes before the reviewer-response deadline.
Preview and re-open each saved note; do not silently delete the correction or upload a revised PDF during a response-only window.
Rotate the exposed W&B, Tinker, and Hugging Face credentials.
Use the E1 audit design, not the May omnibus, as the base for an ACL or ARR resubmission, but repair and independently verify its statistical pipeline first.
untested_gaps: No OpenReview note was posted or edited.
Private W&B and Hugging Face evidence is not independently visible to reviewers unless an anonymized artifact is supplied.
Reference-KL dependence remains untested because E1 uses beta=0.
The frozen E1 aggregate still labels DAPO DISAPPEARS; that verdict is superseded by the conservative re-audit and must not be quoted.
No prospective ZVF intervention or compute-saving result exists.
